titleTr: Öğretmenin notu: rica ve emirleri aktarmak

grammar.topic: Reported requests and commands (asked me to / told me not to)
explainTr: Rica ya da emri aktarırken that cümlesi kurmayız; 'asked / told + kişi + to + fiil' kullanırız: 'Please wait.' → She asked me to wait. 'Sit down!' → He told us to sit down.
Olumsuzda 'not' to'dan önce gelir: 'Don't run!' → The teacher told them not to run. 'Don't to run' veya 'to not run' gibi kalıplardan kaçın.
'Ask' nazik rica, 'tell' daha net emir için kullanılır. İkisinden sonra da kişi (me, us, him) mutlaka gelir.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'Oturmamı söyledi' tek bir yapıdır. İngilizcede 'She told me to sit' dersin; kişi (me) ve 'to' eksik olmamalı. 'She told to sit' hatalıdır.
table: "Please help." → She asked me to help.
"Sit down!" → He told us to sit down.
asked / told + kişi + not to + fiil
"Don't talk." → She told us not to talk.

reading.title: Ms. Park's sub note
reading.text:
On Thursday, Hafsa substituted for Ms. Park's fifth-grade class. When she arrived, she found a sub note on the desk. It was a long note, so she read it slowly.

Ms. Park asked her to take attendance first and to send the list to the office. She told Hafsa to hand out a reading worksheet at 8:30. She also asked her to walk the students to the lunchroom at noon and to stay with them. The note said that Hafsa could ask Ms. Kim next door for help.

At the end, there was a warning. Ms. Park told Hafsa not to let the students use their phones and not to leave the room without a hall pass. She also asked her to leave a short note about the day.

The morning went well. At lunch, Mr. Brown stopped by. "Did you find the sub note?" he asked.

"Yes," Hafsa answered. "Ms. Park asked me to take attendance and to send the list to you. She told me not to let the children use their phones."

"Good," he said. "That is the most important rule."

After school, Hafsa wrote her own note. She asked Ms. Park to check the worksheets and told her that the class had been wonderful. Then she put the note under the stapler, exactly where she had found hers.

writing.promptTr: Bir öğretmenin sub planında senden istediklerini bir arkadaşına anlat. Asked me to / told me (not) to kullan.
writing.promptEn: Tell a friend what a teacher asked or told you to do in a sub note.
frames: She also told me not to ...
writing.model: Hi Linda, I substituted for Ms. Park today. She left me a long note. She asked me to take attendance and to send the list to the office. She told me to hand out a reading worksheet at 8:30. She also told me not to let the students use their phones. She asked me not to leave the room without a hall pass. At the end, she asked me to write a note about the day. I followed every instruction, and the class was wonderful. I was proud of myself. See you soon, Hafsa
checklistTr: Asked / told + kişi + to + fiil yapısını kullandın mı?
Olumsuzda 'not to' var mı (don't to değil)?
Cümleler büyük harfle başlıyor ve noktayla bitiyor mu?
